title: As-asked tidy (C): one owner for the block's words and brief hint, reason comments, retirement notes
description:
## As asked

Piece **C** of LIN-4354 ("LIN-4345 tidy-after: one home for each rule around the As-asked block"). The parent's scope, John's rulings and the full approved plan (revision 2) are in LIN-4354's description under `## Implementation Plan`, decisions 5–8. Its approving review is comment `ccfeb340-79d8-4512-980e-451a194088df`, and that review's builder notes 2 and 3 apply to this piece. Repository: `JKershaw/LinearViewer` (Harbour).

**Starting point.** The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts. Read it in full in LIN-4354's description. Follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4354.

**Lands after pieces A and B.** It rewrites comments in code they move.

## This piece's slice of the approved plan

**Decision 5: one owner for the agent-facing words.**

* **The marker.** Every agent-facing string in `lib/` and `routes/` that spells `## As asked` or the full end sentence interpolates `AS_ASKED_HEADING` or `AS_ASKED_END` from `lib/as-asked.js`. Comments and docs keep the literal text. The plan's grep at `cdc324bc` found about 25:
  * `prompt-contract.js:24`
  * `completion-signals.js:159,181,195`
  * `prompt-template-defs.js:255,764,886,1062`
  * `periodicals.js:223`
  * `chat-tools.js:294`
  * `proxy-preamble.js:266`
  * `proxy-instructions.js:302,764,777,787,792,793,861`
  * `prompts/autopilot-kickoff.js:563,715`
  * `prompts/flight-companion-kickoff.js:101`
  * `routes/workspace-api-feedback.js:114`
  * `routes/proxy-writes.js:66,362,629`

  Re-grep at the current HEAD before starting.
* **The shortened end spelling** (note 2). `proxy-instructions.js:764,777` writes `*End of what was asked. …*`. Either derive it from a short-form export beside `AS_ASKED_END`, or write down why it stays literal. Either way, keep its bytes.
* **The brief hint.**
  * It is copied in five places: `proxy-preamble.js:266`, `proxy-instructions.js:302`, `chat-tools.js:294`, `prompts/autopilot-kickoff.js:715` and `prompts/flight-companion-kickoff.js:101`.
  * It becomes one exported phrase in `as-asked.js`, beside `composeBrief`, using the preamble's current wording. Each surface keeps only its own framing around it.
  * These five surfaces' bytes do change. Update their goldens (`tests/fixtures/autopilot-kickoff/scoped-snapshot-golden.txt` and the preamble tests), add a row to `scripts/prompt-template-change-log.md`, and stay within the `prompt-size-budget` ceilings.

**Decision 6: comments say reasons, not plan labels.** Comments added by LIN-4351 to LIN-4353 cite plan labels, for example "beat 3", "builder note 1", "likeliest break 2", "limit 3", "piece B", "plan rev 2 step 6" and "step 5". So do about 32 test names, such as "witness 4 (dispatch)". Rewrite each one to state its reason, or drop it. These are in:

* `as-asked.js`
* `as-asked-seal.js`
* `dispatch-factory.js`
* `recommendation-facts.js`
* `plan-review-round-trips.js`
* `routes/proxy-writes.js`
* the tests for those pieces

Labels older than those commits are out of scope.

**Decision 7: written conditions for retirement, beside the code. No bulk seal.**

* **The first-dispatch seal** (`sealOnFirstDispatch`, `carriesStageState`, `hasDispatchForIssue`) can go only when both of these hold:
  * no ticket can reach its first dispatch without passing a Harbour create lane;
  * the `[as-asked] sealed at first dispatch` log has stayed at zero over a stated window.
* **The blockless reader paths** (`readFact`'s unsealed branch, `askedText`'s fallthrough, `checkAsAsked`'s `none`) stay while any description can be unsealed. Today they are effectively permanent, and the note says so.
* **The provider interface.** `lib/providers/interface.js:101` gets one line naming `descriptionRoundTrip` as off-surface, like `issueDescription`.

**Decision 8: the LIN-4085 replay test stands on its own fixture.** `tests/unit/as-asked-lin4085-replay.test.js:28,84` reads `docs/reviews/lin-4085-ab-run-2026-11-01.md` at runtime. Remove that read and its provenance assertion. Keep the fixture's provenance in the header comment.

## Interaction found at breakdown: open PR #2348

PR #2348 is LIN-4345's parent-quote ruling. At breakdown it was open at head `53f476b3`. The plan was written before it.

* It adds `## As asked on the parent` / `*End of what was asked on the parent.*` (`PARENT_HEADING` / `PARENT_END` in `brief.js`) and another `## As asked` mention in `completion-signals.js`.
* It also edits the replay test, `prompt-template-defs.js`, `prompt-size-budget.test.js` and the change log.

If it has merged:

* the census must cover those literals: derive them from `AS_ASKED_HEADING`, or explain in a documented allowance why they stay;
* re-check decision 8 against its version of the replay test.

## Testing (the plan's witnesses 5, 6 and 7)

**Witness 5: a new marker census test.** It fails on any agent-facing literal that spells the heading or the full end sentence in `lib/` or `routes/` outside `as-asked.js`.

* It skips `//` comment lines and JSDoc. For JSDoc, use `^\s*\*(\s|\/|$)` or skip only lines inside `/** … */`. Do **not** use a blanket leading-`*` skip, because the end sentence itself starts with `*` (note 3).
* The census's own test includes a fixture template line that starts with the end sentence, and shows that line is still caught.
* It fails today on about 25 literals and passes after.
* The prompt goldens and byte pins pass **unchanged**, except on the five brief-hint surfaces.

**Witness 6.** The replay test passes with `docs/reviews/` temporarily moved away.

**Witness 7.** `npm run test:unit` and `test:hermetic` are green, as are the prompt-size checks, prompt goldens and byte pins.

**Label check.** This grep lists the labels at the start:

```
git diff e63c2f69..cdc324bc -- lib routes tests | grep '^+' | grep -E 'beat [0-9]|[Ww]itness [0-9]|builder note|likeliest break|limit [0-9]|piece [ABC]\b|plan rev|step [0-9]'
```

Run the same pattern over the files at HEAD afterwards. It should find no hits in lines those pieces wrote.

## Done when

* Every agent-facing marker and the brief hint have one owner.
* No plan-label comments remain from LIN-4351 to LIN-4353.
* The retirement conditions and the interface line are written beside the code.
* The replay test no longer reads `docs/reviews/`.
* The only prompt bytes that change are the five brief-hint surfaces.

Session fit: fits one session

Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4354's approving plan-review (comment ccfeb340-79d8-4512-980e-451a194088df, rev 2)

**Grounding commits:**

* `cdc324bc` (HEAD the plan was read and approved at; LIN-4353)
* `d81e13e7` (LIN-4352)
* `fdd57fe9` (LIN-4351)
* `e63c2f69` (base for the label grep)

**Landing order:** blocked by pieces A and B.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Outcome

Implemented in PR [#2352](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2352>), squash-merged as `4654832f` and deployed to Harbour production (footer `4654832f`).

Decisions 5–8 of LIN-4354's approved plan (rev 2) were implemented as approved. The departures John's review accepted are recorded on LIN-4354, comment `319090cc`:

* source-ceiling increases (+74 / +74 / +148), which are code growth only;
* hint-only re-pins in `tests/fixtures/lin-4251-work-blocks.json`.

Close-out made review's one wording fix, `28db2b60`: `get_brief` keeps its sealed-description condition.

The full history (review, build notes, close-out summary) is in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

comments.body: **Landing order decided: #2348 first** (ruling `lin4354-pr2348-order` → `pr2348-first`, John, 18:01). Start this piece from `main` after #2348, LIN-4360 (#2350) and LIN-4361 (merged as `93a37ab6`) have all landed. Cover #2348's parent markers in the census, and re-check decision 8 against #2348's version of `as-asked-lin4085-replay.test.js`. Details are on LIN-4354.

## LIN-4362 (piece C): PR open, CI green

**PR:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2352. The branch is `feat/lin-4362-as-asked-tidy-c` at head `01520ade`. It is not merged; review and close-out own that.

**CI** (run `42410143634` at `01520ade`): all green.
- Unit tests pass. That covers the hermetic keyed arm and the proxy arm with the +400-day clock shift, against a real MongoDB.
- E2E shards 1 to 4 pass.
- The secret scan passes, and so does `CI success`.
- Locally, the unit arms ran without `MONGODB_TEST_URI`, so the real-MongoDB smoke test is the part CI adds.
- Locally, one e2e test failed: `tests/e2e/live-console.spec.js:444`, a mobile layout pin. It fails the same way on `origin/main` locally and passes on CI, so it is down to the local environment, not this change.

**What landed** (decisions 5 to 8 of LIN-4354's plan):
- **Decision 5: one owner for the words.** All 27 agent-facing `## As asked` spellings in `lib/` and `routes/` now interpolate `AS_ASKED_HEADING`. The short end form and the parent forms are built from the markers. The brief hint is one wording, `BRIEF_HINT`, beside `composeBrief`. The new census test `tests/unit/as-asked-marker-census.test.js` fails on any new hand spelling.
- **Decision 6: comments state reasons, not plan labels.** Comments and test names that cited plan labels now give the reason. Test renames change names only.
- **Decision 7: retirement conditions beside the code.**
  - The first-dispatch seal can go only when no ticket reaches its first dispatch without a Harbour create lane, and the `[as-asked] sealed at first dispatch` log line has stayed at zero for 30 days after that.
  - The blockless reader paths are effectively permanent.
  - `interface.js` names `descriptionRoundTrip` as off-surface.
- **Decision 8: the replay test stands on its own fixture.** It no longer reads `docs/reviews/`.

**Evidence**
- **Census:** it failed on 27 lines before the change and passes 15 of 15 after. Planting literals in `lib/` and `routes/` on the final tree made it fail, naming both.
- **Replay test:** it passes with `docs/reviews/` moved away.
- **Unit and hermetic arms, run locally:** 24,152 of 24,152 pass.
- **Byte check:** 211 rendered variants compared, 46 changed, all on the five hint surfaces and only on the hint line.

**For review to look at**
1. **Derived forms:** `AS_ASKED_END_SHORT` and `PARENT_END` are built from the end sentence's stem, and `PARENT_HEADING` from `AS_ASKED_HEADING`. Their bytes are identical to the old literals.
2. **Source-size ceilings raised:** `prompt-template-defs.js` and `prompt-contract.js` each rose by 74 bytes, and `FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES` by 148. The growth is code, not prompt text; rendered bytes are unchanged. Each ceiling equals the measured size exactly, with the reason beside it.
3. **Hint re-pins, on the hint line only:** the autopilot golden, the preamble pin, and 18 blocks in `tests/fixtures/lin-4251-work-blocks.json` (the plan didn't name this fixture). The change-log row is filled with PR #2352.
4. **The 30-day retirement window.**
5. **The census is wider than the ticket's wording:** it catches every form of the end sentence, and lists no exceptions.
6. **The decision 8 test rename.**

The departures from the plan are recorded on LIN-4354, comment `319090cc`.

## Review — LIN-4362

Reviewed PR [#2352](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2352) at head `01520ade`, branch `feat/lin-4362-as-asked-tidy-c`. The branch's merge-base is the current `main`, `9a29dd55`, so it includes #2348, #2350 (A) and `93a37ab6` (B), as John's landing ruling requires. GitHub reports it MERGEABLE.

CI: green. Run `42410143634` is on `01520ade` exactly: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, the source secret scan and CI success all pass.

### What I checked myself
- **Census (witness 5).** `tests/unit/as-asked-marker-census.test.js` passes, 15/15. Outside comments, a grep of `lib/` and `routes/` at head finds no `## As asked` or `*End of what was asked` spelling except in `lib/as-asked.js`. Nothing in `public/`, `content/` or `server.js` spells either one.
- **Mutation checks.** I reverted each mutation afterwards.
  - M1: I put `AS_ASKED_LEAD` in `routes/proxy-writes.js:66` back to the literal `"## As asked"`. The census goes red and names `routes/proxy-writes.js:66`.
  - M2: I replaced `${BRIEF_HINT}` in the Flight Companion kickoff with a paraphrase. The surface test goes red: "Flight Companion kickoff does not carry BRIEF_HINT".
  - M3: I changed the tail of `AS_ASKED_END`, after its first clause. The census stays green and `AS_ASKED_END_SHORT` keeps its bytes. That is intended: the short form is derived from the sentence's first clause.
  - M4: I changed how `PARENT_END` is built. 5 tests across the `as-asked*` suites go red, so the derived parent form keeps its bytes.
  - The fixture for note 3 (a template line that starts with the end sentence) is caught.
  - I could not run the census on base, because base lacks the new exports. Instead I checked that each of the 27 spellings in the diff became an interpolation of the same bytes.
- **Replay (witness 6).** With `docs/reviews/` moved away, `as-asked-lin4085-replay.test.js` passes 4/4. The runtime read and its provenance assertion are gone, and the provenance is now in the header comment. #2348's parent-quote assertions are still there.
- **Hint re-pins.** All 18 changed blocks in `tests/fixtures/lin-4251-work-blocks.json` change one thing only: `block;\nno step` becomes `block; no step`. I checked them by script, 18/18. The autopilot golden and the preamble pin change only on the hint line. `prompt-templates.test.js` changes in comments only. No rendered ceiling moved.
- **Labels (decision 6).** The ticket's grep over `e63c2f69..cdc324bc` finds 47 added label lines. None of them is still in `lib/`, `routes/` or `tests/` at head. Three pattern hits remain in `plan-review-round-trips.js`: `follow-on-ratio`'s numbered "limit 7", which was only reflowed, and two from August and September. None is a LIN-4351–4353 plan label.
- **Regression check.** I ran `git log` on every touched file. There are no reverts, and no recent fix that this PR undoes. #2348's `completion-signals.js` and `prompt-template-defs.js` edits are kept and interpolated, not reworded.
- **One of a class?** The class is "a hand copy of the marker or the brief hint". The census closes the marker side mechanically for `lib/` and `routes/`. For the hint, a search for "person's words" finds no sixth surface. As far as these two classes go, the change is isolated.

### Departures from the plan (comment `319090cc` on LIN-4354)
- **Source ceilings rose: `prompt-template-defs.js` +74, `prompt-contract.js` +74, `FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES` +148.** I accept this.
  - Decision 5 itself tells the builder to interpolate at those lines. That cannot be done without the import and concatenation bytes.
  - There was no slack to pay for them. Each ceiling equals its measured size, and the total is their exact sum.
  - Paying for them by cutting prompt text would break "the only prompt bytes that change are the five surfaces".
  - The ask's "stay within the `prompt-size-budget` ceilings" is in the brief-hint bullet. Those five surfaces' rendered ceilings are untouched and still pass.
  - The repo has precedent for code-not-prompt growth, with the reason recorded beside the ceiling: LIN-4251 and LIN-4253.
- **Re-pinning `lin-4251-work-blocks.json` is required.** That fixture pins the preamble, which is one of the five surfaces the ask lets change. The change is hint-only, verified above.
- **Derived short and parent forms, a census with no exceptions, the 30-day window, and the replay rename all fit the ask.** Note 2 allows either derivation or a documented literal. The PR derives, and the bytes are pinned by test. The plan left the window open.

### Finding (for close-out to fix)
1. **`lib/chat-tools.js:294` (the `get_brief` tool description) dropped its own condition.** It used to say the brief opens with the person's words *"where the description has an `## As asked` block"*. Now it says so unconditionally, which is false for an unsealed ticket.
   - The proxy instructions kept the matching framing ("On a sealed description it opens with …").
   - The ask has each surface keep its own framing around `BRIEF_HINT`, and this condition was framing.
   - **Fix:** in `lib/chat-tools.js`, change the line `` `developments, opening with ${BRIEF_HINT}. This is a cache-only read ` + `` to `` `developments, opening, where the description has an \`${AS_ASKED_HEADING}\` block, with ${BRIEF_HINT}. This is a cache-only read ` + ``.
   - Also import `AS_ASKED_HEADING` alongside `BRIEF_HINT`.
   - The census surface test keeps passing, because the text still includes `BRIEF_HINT`.

Non-blocking notes, no action needed:
- The preamble's hint line is now one line of about 170 characters, where it used to wrap at about 95. The ask allows this surface's bytes to change.
- The census skips a whole line that starts with `/* … */` and has code after it. Nothing in the tree does that.

### What CI Did Not Prove
CI covers the deliverable; ledger empty.
- The claim "the only prompt bytes that change are the five hint surfaces" holds by construction. Every non-hint edit replaces a literal with an export of the same bytes, and the derived forms are pinned by test. I checked this line by line in the diff, and the goldens and byte pins pass unchanged apart from the hint surfaces.
- The retirement conditions describe a future decision. Nothing in this deliverable depends on them.
- The one open item is the fix above. It is a fix, not a ledger claim.

### Verdict
How the work meets what was asked, sentence by sentence:
- **Decision 5, the marker:** all 27 agent-facing spellings interpolate `AS_ASKED_HEADING`; comments and docs keep the text. That is the plan's ~25, plus `prompt-contract.js:43` and `completion-signals.js:197`.
- **Re-grep at HEAD:** done; it found 27.
- **Shortened end spelling:** derived as `AS_ASKED_END_SHORT`, with its bytes kept and pinned.
- **Brief hint:** one `BRIEF_HINT` beside `composeBrief`, in the preamble's wording, used by all five surfaces. Their goldens and the preamble tests are updated, the change-log row is added, and the rendered ceilings are untouched. The one framing slip, `get_brief`, is the fix above.
- **Decision 6:** the label comments and test names from LIN-4351–4353 are rewritten to reasons. The grep finds no hits left in those lines.
- **Decision 7:**
  - The first-dispatch seal's two conditions are written at `sealOnFirstDispatch`, with cross-notes at `carriesStageState` and `hasDispatchForIssue`.
  - The blockless reader paths are noted as effectively permanent at `readFact`, `askedText` and `checkAsAsked`.
  - `interface.js` names `descriptionRoundTrip` as off-surface. No bulk seal.
- **Decision 8:** the replay test no longer reads `docs/reviews/`, and the provenance is in its header.
- **PR #2348 interaction:** the parent markers are derived from the owner's words and the census covers them. Decision 8 was re-checked against #2348's version of the test.
- **Witnesses 5, 6 and 7:** met, as shown above and by CI.
- **Label check:** met.
- **Done when:** met, apart from the one `get_brief` framing fix.

Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

**Autopilot (verb override note).** After review's conditional Approve on PR #2352 (comment f1ce0d49, ledger empty, one wording fix for close-out), `recommend-and-dispatch` returned `implementation` (dispatch 60a0807a), which would have re-run the whole task and opened a duplicate PR. The engine's pick was wrong: the task is Approved-but-unmerged, so the next step is `close-out`. I aborted that session (cancelled within ~20s, no new PR or push; PR #2352 head still 01520ade) and pinned `kind: close-out` (dispatch f0783ba4). Recorded so the heuristic can learn that a conditional Approve with an empty ledger and a close-out-sized fix routes to close-out.

## Close-out — LIN-4362

**Merged:** PR [#2352](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2352). It was squash-merged as `4654832f` at 20:43Z, pinned with `--match-head-commit` to `28db2b60`, the head CI passed on. The merge tree is identical to `28db2b60` (`git diff 28db2b60 4654832f` is empty).

**Deployed:** GitHub deployment `7626783315` (Harbour / production) for `4654832f` succeeded, and the harbour.cat footer shows `4654832f`.

**How it meets what was asked:** see review comment `f1ce0d49`. Its sentence-by-sentence account covers decisions 5–8, the #2348 interaction, witnesses 5–7, the label check and "Done when". The one exception it named was the `get_brief` framing fix, which is now done (below).

### Change made after the approval
- **`28db2b60`** — `lib/chat-tools.js`: `get_brief` keeps its sealed-description condition. This answers review finding 1 ("`lib/chat-tools.js:294` … dropped its own condition"). The change is exactly the one review gave: `AS_ASKED_HEADING` is imported beside `BRIEF_HINT`, and the description reads "opening, where the description has an \`${AS_ASKED_HEADING}\` block, with ${BRIEF_HINT}". The rendered text was checked locally: "…opening, where the description has an \`## As asked\` block, with the person's words, quoted from …". No goldens or ceilings moved. `chat-tools.js` has no source-size ceiling, and the census and surface tests still pass because the text still carries `BRIEF_HINT`.
- No stale citations or comments needed fixing beyond this.

### Ledger
Review recorded "CI covers the deliverable; ledger empty", so there was nothing to settle. There were no outside items, so no follow-ups were filed. There were no rulings on LIN-4362.

### Post-deploy
- The ticket and review named no post-deploy steps.
- I checked the landed change on production. The deployed commit is `4654832f`. The live `GET /api/proxy/instructions` serves the shared hint inside its own framing ("On a sealed description it opens with the person's words, quoted from the description's \`## As asked\` block; …"), which is one of this PR's five hint surfaces.
- The chat tool's `get_brief` description has no read surface through the proxy. It is confirmed in the deployed source at `4654832f:lib/chat-tools.js:294`.

### Final CI
Run `42411612419` on `28db2b60` passed: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source) and CI success. Before pushing, the local `npm run test:unit` passed 24,152 of 24,152.

### Accepted departures (recorded, not new)
John's review accepted the source-ceiling increases (+74 / +74 / `FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES` +148) and the hint-only re-pins in `tests/fixtures/lin-4251-work-blocks.json`. See LIN-4354 comment `319090cc`.

**Autopilot run summary (stepper, session 34e80625).**

**Beats (one warm worker session, ROOT c084637c, opus-4.8):**
1. Re-ground and census witness: branch cut from main 9a29dd55, #2348 confirmed merged (8198bd40), 27 literals found (plan said ~25), census test written and shown failing on all 27.
2. Decision 5 (commit 2628007c): every literal interpolates AS_ASKED_HEADING/AS_ASKED_END; short end form and PARENT_* derived with bytes kept; one exported BRIEF_HINT; 211 render variants compared before/after, only the 46 hint-surface variants changed.
3. Decisions 6-8 (bb81eb4c): plan labels rewritten to reasons, 16 test renames, retirement notes (30-day window) beside the code, interface.js line, replay test off docs/reviews/ (witness 6 shown).
4. Verification (ef739474): unit/hermetic/keyed/proxy 24,152/24,152 each, secret scan clean, census mutation checks, assertion-diff review, LIN-4354 departure comment 319090cc.
5. PR #2352 opened, CI green (run 42410143634).

**Then:** review (05f39e2a) gave a conditional Approve (f1ce0d49) with an empty ledger and one wording fix; close-out (f0783ba4) made the fix (28db2b60), CI run 42411612419 green on that exact commit, squash-merged as 4654832f, deployed, set Done (summary d863045d).

**Evidence I checked myself:** PR state MERGED with all 7 checks SUCCESS on 28db2b60; fix visible in the merged lib/chat-tools.js; LIN-4362 state Done.

**One verb override:** after review the engine returned implementation instead of close-out; I aborted that session within ~20s (no push, no new PR) and pinned close-out (note 8d51cc85).

**What holds / what's left:** the work holds. Not run locally: the real-MongoDB smoke test (CI covered it). The local e2e failure at tests/e2e/live-console.spec.js:444 also fails on origin/main locally and passed in CI. The parent LIN-4354 is not closed here; close-out left it a note (ec6fff64).

issue.title: As-asked tidy (B): one issue access and one read per dispatch for the seal and plan read
As-asked tidy (A): one due-line reader, outsideAsAsked, pure brief composer and one mock brief
